Report equivalent cases deliberately left unchanged with the concrete reason. This is not a request for a second unrelated broad redesign or validation matrix. Reports: Vert.x 7 tests, 0 skipped; OpenTelemetry API 1 test, 0 skipped; Pekko 185 tests, 37 skipped; 0 failures/errors in all three.
- `./gradlew :instrumentation:vertx:vertx-kafka-client-3.6:javaagent:check :instrumentation:opentelemetry-api:opentelemetry-api-1.38:javaagent:check :instrumentation:pekko:pekko-http-1.0:javaagent:check --dry-run` — **BUILD SUCCESSFUL**; all three check graphs included their affected execution tasks. Some supporting build tasks were `UP-TO-DATE`. Develocity cache lookups failed because `community.develocity.cloud` could not resolve; Gradle disabled the remote cache and all commands still succeeded. The changed-build scan found no additional equivalent `targets/all/testTask` defaults or empty named `test` wrappers. Pekko’s cross-suite JVM flags and Scala source shims were left unchanged because they apply across suites/source sets. CodeQL reported no changes in analyzable languages, so no analysis was performed.
